facts.fact: Mozambique's Ministry of Education presented its EMIS (StatEduc), updated in 2021 and 2022, as fed by censuses covering primary, secondary, adult education and school mapping.
The Ministry's Head of Statistics said Mozambique plans a fully digital platform for real-time entry, piloting tools like DHIS2 for offline dashboards.

note: Describes one district's use of EMIS down to school level; no national system, census or learner record stated.

facts.fact: The education ministry's Planning and Cooperation Directorate runs the annual 3 March school census (Levantamento Escolar 2024, public and private schools) and its Statistics Department publishes the resulting education statistics brochure each year.

systems.owner: Ministério da Educação e Desenvolvimento Humano

facts.fact: A GPE KIX-supported assessment on 3-4 August 2026 found Mozambique has an established EMIS with multiple education data subsystems, electronic data platforms and processes for validating and disseminating education statistics, and that education statistics already inform teacher deployment and resource allocation.

note: A statistics office microdata catalogue listing school survey datasets; it states nothing about an education management information system.
An IDRC research grant record for an education data platform; Mozambique is named only as a country that called for support, with no ministry system or digital-policy research stated.
The country is named only as having called for support to improve data-driven decisions; no EMIS state is given.

facts.fact: DHIS2 said the Norad-funded DHIS2-Ed pilot in Mozambique focused on the largest provinces.
DHIS2 profile says Mozambique's DHIS2 for Education has run in two provinces since 2019, with the Basic Education Department piloting DHIS2-DEMIS at district level.
